environment.observed_identity: PostgreSQL 18.6 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by clang version 21.1.8, 64-bit
environment.client_transport: rust postgres crate 0.19, one synchronous TCP connection per concurrency slot, prepared statements, autocommit per statement

comparability.seed_policy: seed-{index}, tenant benchmark-tenant, index modulo seed count
comparability.document_policy: seed documents have id seed-{index}, name user-{index}, group index modulo 100, 256-byte payload
comparability.operation_policy: mixed uses index modulo 10: 0..4 read, 5..7 write, 8..9 query; read/query address index modulo seed count
comparability.write_id_policy: measured writes use measured-{global operation index}
comparability.durability_semantics: synchronous_commit=on; fsync=on; full_page_writes=on; autocommit statement acknowledgement

limits: server-side configuration is the SE-15 pin's, captured verbatim on the receipt
planner and memory settings are the pinned artifact's shipped defaults; no ANALYZE beyond what warm-up naturally produces
